theme.name: Ink Studio
theme.tagline: Design a tattoo that fits the client's wish – motif, style, ink and placement.
brief.first_wrist.title: First tattoo
brief.first_wrist.desc: Someone wants their very first tattoo: small and delicate on the wrist, something from the night sky, fine line in black & grey.
brief.sailor_forearm.title: Harbour memories
brief.sailor_forearm.desc: A maritime piece for the forearm in a bold traditional look with full colour.
brief.summit_back.title: Summit
brief.summit_back.desc: A large back piece celebrating adventure and the mountains. Dotwork in black & grey.
brief.romance_wrist.title: Little love note
brief.romance_wrist.desc: A small romantic motif for the wrist – soft watercolour with colour.
brief.freedom_forearm.title: Free as a bird
brief.freedom_forearm.desc: A forearm design about freedom, geometric and in black & grey.
brief.night_sky_back.title: Night sky
brief.night_sky_back.desc: A large, airy celestial piece across the back. Fine line, black & grey.
brief.ocean_forearm.title: Ocean soul
brief.ocean_forearm.desc: Something maritime for the forearm, in flowing watercolour with colour.
brief.garden_forearm.title: Garden bloom
brief.garden_forearm.desc: Flowers on the forearm in a classic traditional style, full colour.
brief.traveler_wrist.title: Wanderlust
brief.traveler_wrist.desc: A tiny adventure symbol on the wrist, fine line in black & grey.
brief.wild_back.title: Into the wild
brief.wild_back.desc: A bold nature back piece: traditional style, full colour.
